metadata.description: Public AI agent skills — practical skills spanning multiple domains, from engineering, idea validation all the way to knowledge management.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Coordinate several agents on one shared goal through a shared work board: orchestrate:pull (alias swarm, peer-to-peer) and orchestrate:assign (alias direct, thin dispatcher), with shared claim/lease/reap mechanics, charter, escalation ladder and role cards.

plugins.name: operating-model
plugins.description: Run work, independent of the domain: policy (the layered .agents/policy settings a skill reads instead of hardcoding a constant), procedure (a named graph of stages with a validator and a reducer that runs it) and agents-dir (the .agents/ layout contract: the documents that define the process and how they evolve).

plugins.name: find-ai-moat
plugins.description: Interview one question at a time to find where your work complements AI versus where a model already does it, then give three concrete 30-day moves to widen the gap in your favor.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Deploy stage for the development procedure: deploy a released or integrated revision and verify it from real logs or state. A failed verification leaves the stage open with the evidence.

plugins.name: dep-pr-triage
plugins.description: Triage open Dependabot and Renovate PRs across orgs: classify each red check, apply the mechanical fix on the PR branch, push, re-check. Never merges or approves.

plugins.name: github-actions
plugins.description: Harden GitHub Actions workflows and configure Renovate — template-injection prevention, SHA-pinned actions, scoped permissions, zizmor, and dependency-bot rules.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and plan before building: architect (work package), ramble (grill a rough idea into a brief), decompose (cut into parallel units), graph-engine (waves and critical path), project-docs (standard docs/ with a validator).

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Read-only review: by-angle (red-first block loop plus four review angles), code-quality (risk from complexity, coverage, duplication metrics, and a comment-quality pass), and security (gitleaks, trufflehog, osv-scanner, semgrep, SkillSpector, garak, nuclei, strix plus an AI triage pass).

plugins.name: swe
plugins.description: Engineering practice skills: rust and typescript (house guidelines on every change) and performance (profile, optimize, benchmark).

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Create, maintain, and query a personal knowledge wiki designed for LLM navigation.

plugins.name: media-digest
plugins.description: Fetch the transcript of any yt-dlp media or the text of a web article, save it locally, and write a loss-checked summary with a short version and follow-up points.

plugins.name: models
plugins.description: Work with the model itself: extension-author (skills, plugins and hooks across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, oh-my-pi) and reflect (mine sessions for agent struggles and propose fixes).

plugins.name: forge-idea
plugins.description: Forge rough ideas into viable ones through cooperative, research-driven iteration.

plugins.name: grounded-research
plugins.description: Research a question under a fixed evidence contract: primary sources first, every claim cited with URL and date, fact kept apart from hearsay.

plugins.name: nix
plugins.description: Operate correctly inside Nix + direnv development repos — dev-shell entry, nix fmt over cargo fmt, the result-symlink and crane-rustflags build traps, and a lightweight pre-commit override.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Plain, human prose: unslop (remove AI tells) and prose-craft (compose and tighten).
